Name: Item Chat Link
Author: dnlsern7
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Item Chat Link lets players link inventory items directly in Stardew Valley multiplayer chat.

Press the configured hotkey while hovering an item in your inventory or toolbar to insert an item link into chat. Players with the mod installed can hover the linked item name to see an item tooltip.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

The final folder should look like:
Stardew Valley/Mods/ItemChatLink/manifest.json[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Insert hovered inventory or toolbar items into chat.
- Display item links as blue, underlined chat text.
- Hover item links to view item tooltips.
- Multiplayer synchronization for players who also have the mod installed.
- Configurable insert hotkey through Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Safe fallback for players without the mod: item links appear as normal chat text.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required:
- SMAPI 4.2.1 or newer
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer

Optional:
- Generic Mod Config Menu, for changing the insert hotkey in-game

All players who want to see item tooltips for shared links should install the mod. Players without the mod will still see normal chat text, but they will not see link styling or tooltips.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the SMAPI and Stardew Valley modding communities for their documentation and tools.[/color]
